title: Conditional Discrete Diffusion for Diverse, Constraint-Aware qPCR Primer-Pair Design
scope: Mouse gene-level transcript primer-pair design; no clinical or pathogen claims
evidence_regime: Unverified database-position imitation is a weak pilot and is reported separately from high-confidence experimental supervision
methods: direct CNN with grammar and single-oligo guidance
discrete diffusion CNN with grammar and single-oligo guidance
uniform F-then-R rule sampler with identical single-oligo guidance
primary_computational_endpoints: fraction of held-out genes with >=2 distinct feasible gene-specific primer sequence pairs
mean unique feasible gene-specific pair count per gene
secondary_endpoints: temperature penalty among jointly covered genes
specificity_tier: limited BLAST+ hit rule, reported with its mismatch and coverage restrictions; independent Primer-BLAST review remains a separate check
statistical_unit: gene, paired across methods; same-gene candidates and seeds are not independent biological replicates
test_policy: Freeze the protocol and source hashes before first full test evaluation. All 75 frozen test genes remain in the denominator, including database-missing or no-design genes. Hyperparameter selection uses validation only.

prospective_experiment.target_selection: Random subset of the frozen test genes selected independently of model feasibility; all model training excludes them
prospective_experiment.status: Not conducted; laboratory resources, materials, and raw data pending
prospective_experiment.success_criteria_status: Must be fixed with the laboratory before candidate unblinding; no outcome-dependent thresholds

conclusion_policy: Report all comparisons including negative outcomes. Never infer experimental success from a source link, thermodynamic pass, BLAST screen, or diffusion loss. Do not claim superiority or first use without evidence.
